about: The two temporary Substack drafts of the fixed version (build_draft.js, from REPLACEMENTS.json and LIVE-INDEX.txt at commit 871a909aa3a51f7690c73a668738e120af4a15bd and the post API), made 2026-11-07 17:52 to 17:55 UTC in the app's built-in browser. Never published, no email; their titles have no detector's name (gate E205). Their secret preview links (paid view) are not kept in Git: substack_secret_link.js makes one from the draft number with a new cache key. They are kept to be pasted again (cleared first) for the whole-article check, which waits until every window a smaller check read AI reads Human in a later smaller check (gate gut-2026-11-07a): S2, S17, the three S2-pattern stretches and the other AI windows of 'Can making love be a spiritual practice?' (#45). Joel deletes them from his drafts list when the check is done (the budget rule: a Claude worker leaves the delete click to him). Re-pasted 2026-11-08 (r27, cleared first, in the built-in browser) with his jealousy answer (#135), S17's doubled "example" taken out (#136) and the fixed Idealization section (#143), from this folder's REPLACEMENTS.json (88 keys, canonical SHA-256 bc856e29a79e…); each secret link's rendered text matched the built text with its quotes curled as the walk curls them. The whole-article check is his, in his browser, on the two secret links.
